hints.title: Sorting on Primary Attribute
hints.text: Sort characters by attack descending. To handle identical attack values cleanly, sort defense in ascending order for ties.

hints.title: Monotonic Maximum Tracking
hints.text: Traverse the sorted characters and maintain the maximum defense observed so far. Any character with defense strictly below this maximum is weak.

hints.title: Tie-Breaking Rationale
hints.text: Sorting defense ascending on equal attack prevents a character with the same attack from marking another as weak.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of character property pairs
complexity.notes: Custom two-level sort followed by a single linear pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs pairwise takes O(N^2) time which is too slow for N = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual-order sorting allows tracking the maximum defense in a single linear sweep.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that sorting defense ascending on attack ties eliminates intra-group false positives.
